page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7.4xlarge is a compute-optimized server instance built on the x86_64 architecture. It features 16 vCPUs provided by 8 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores operating at 2.7 GHz, utilizing dedicated allocation under a KVM hypervisor. The instance is provisioned with 32 GB of system memory, providing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU. Hardware features include 48 MB of L3 cache along with instruction extensions such as AVX-512 VNNI, AES, and FMA. The instance provides 10 Gbps baseline network bandwidth, contains no integrated GPUs, and includes no local ephemeral storage.

Benchmark evaluations position the ecs.c7.4xlarge within average performance tiers across CPU and memory tests. The instance records a PassMark CPU score of 20865.11, a multi-core stress-ng result of 15477.28, and a Geekbench multi-core score of 9153.0. In application-specific metrics, it achieves 14976.0 on Geekbench Clang software compilation, 15.34 million operations per second for Redis SET requests, and 18.93 GB/sec static web serving throughput. Large-block uncached memory read bandwidth is measured at 93.71 GB/sec. Prompt processing speed for 7B parameter LLMs registers at 31.09 tokens per second, representing a lower tier relative to general hardware capabilities.

The 1:2 RAM-to-vCPU ratio offers efficient resource allocation for compute-bound tasks that do not demand large per-core memory footprints. The lack of bundled local storage requires deployment with attached network block storage. Given its processing metrics and network throughput, the instance is suited for web serving, microservices, software compilation, Redis key-value caching, and lightweight text generation workloads.
